"On this Android version, the MusicBrainz form opens in your browser (the in-app browser can\'t connect securely). Firefox is recommended, because it has its own certificate list. Sign in to MusicBrainz in the browser, then submit. After submitting, the browser shows an error page; that\'s expected."
"The cover image was saved to %1$s. After submitting, add it on the release page (Cover Art → Add cover art)."

"On this version of Android, the app plays through the output Android chooses (speaker, wired headphones or Bluetooth). Connect a USB DAC to play through it directly."
"Allow access to music and audio to show your library."
"Sends audio to the DAC without Android\'s resampling (bit-perfect). DSD files are sent as native DSD or DoP when the DAC supports it (see DSD playback)."

"Allowing this lets the app read folders and track info directly from files, so the library loads faster. The app works fine without it."
"Along with your rip folder, you can add other music folders on your device. Songs in them can be played, and their track info can be fetched or edited."

"Plays songs on a Chromecast or other Google Cast device on the same Wi-Fi network (experimental). The device decodes the audio, so UCRT's USB DAC direct output, equalizer and DAR aren't used. ALAC, AIFF, WavPack and APE are sent as WAV, and audio above 96 kHz is converted to half the sample rate. DSD files and direct CD playback can't be cast."
"To find and use Cast devices on your network, allow access to nearby devices"

"Plain text, or LRC with times ([mm:ss.xx] lyrics) for synced lyrics"

"Only to tell apart releases with the same title (e.g. limited edition)"
"After the release is submitted, the add cover art page opens and the image is chosen automatically"
"Sent to LRCLIB (lrclib.net, an open lyrics database), since MusicBrainz doesn\'t store lyrics. Songs that already have lyrics there are skipped"
"This album (same title, artist and number of tracks) is already on MusicBrainz, so the track info was not submitted."

"CD quality at about half the size. Recommended"
"Choosing the USB DAC enables bit-perfect playback (the app controls the DAC directly)"
"All songs will be removed from sound check. The song files won't be deleted."
"%1$s\nConnect an external drive over USB. If it doesn't get enough power, use a self-powered USB hub."
"Constant bitrate (CBR). 320 kbps gives the best quality."

"Controls the USB DAC directly with the app's own driver, bypassing Android's audio system. With source direct on, audio data is sent completely unaltered (bit-perfect). The app takes exclusive control of the DAC, so notification sounds won't play through it"
"Converts the source to DSD and sends it as native DSD or DoP. Requires a DSD-capable DAC"
"Corrects the drive's read position offset. Set to 0 if unsure."
"Couldn't check for updates. Check your network connection"
"Couldn't search due to a network error"
"Create one from a song or album menu, or by saving the queue"

"While a USB DAC or wired headphones are connected, keeps sending silence so the DAC doesn't go to sleep. Can help with dropouts, clipped starts and pops in any app. Shows a notification while active and uses a little more battery."
"UCRT is using the USB DAC directly, so its own dropout prevention is used instead"
"Keep the DAC awake for all apps (experimental)"
"Waiting for a device to be connected"

"DAR applies to PCM tracks (files and CDs) when source direct is off. PCM upsampling works with both USB DAC direct output and the standard output (such as the headphone jack); with the standard output, it upsamples only as high as the output accepts. DSD conversion requires USB DAC direct output. DSD tracks play unchanged. With DAR on, playback is no longer bit-perfect and uses more battery"
"DAR: Switched to DSD%1$s (this device is too slow for DSD%2$s)"
"Don't disconnect the drive or let the device sleep while writing"
"Downloaded cover art is for personal use only."
"Drag a point to change its frequency and gain. Tap a point to change its type and width. Double-tap an empty area to add a band"
"Drives the USB DAC with the app's own driver (bit-perfect, native DSD)"
"The app can't control this DAC's volume, so DSD plays at full volume. Adjust the volume on the DAC itself"
"DSD tracks cannot be written to a CD"
"The equalizer and DAR are bypassed while source direct is on"

"Hides the navigation bar at the bottom of the screen (the back and home buttons, or the gesture bar) to use more of the screen. Swipe up from the bottom edge to show it briefly"
"When a song has its own embedded artwork, the song lists and the player show it instead of the album artwork"
"Uses the ReplayGain values written in the songs to even out loudness differences between them"
"Per album keeps the loudness differences between songs on the same album (uses the track value when there's no album value)"
"Limits the boost using the song's peak value so loud passages don't distort"

"Songs without ReplayGain values play unchanged. Reads FLAC, MP3, M4A (AAC / ALAC), WavPack, APE, AIFF, WAV and DSF tags. Not applied to DSD playback, DAR's DSD conversion or CDs. Turns off bit-perfect playback while a gain is applied, and isn't used when source direct is on"

"Measures each song's loudness (EBU R128) and works out ReplayGain values per track and per album. The values are only used for songs that have no ReplayGain tags, and the song files are not changed. Analysis can take a long time for a large library; keep the app open. DSD files are skipped"
"Choose a color not in the swatches with the color picker"
"This color is close to the background and may be hard to read. Switching between light and dark themes keeps the same text color"
"Songs playing in other music apps (Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music and more) appear here"
"To show songs playing in other music apps here, turn on \"Show and control other apps' playback\" below and allow notification access"
"Browse your Spotify library and play it in the official Spotify app"

"Requires Spotify Premium and registering your own app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard (see the setup screen). Audio plays from the Spotify app, so UCRT's USB DAC direct output, equalizer and DAR don't apply"
"Pauses playback and gives the USB DAC back to Android, so other apps can play through it (UCRT takes it again when you start playback)"
"Gave the USB DAC back to Android"
"Stops playback, gives the USB DAC back to Android and fully closes the app"
"Moves the tabs to the left side and, on wide screens, keeps the player open next to the library. Auto turns it on for tablets and other large screens."
"MP3: bitrate setting not supported, saved with the default"
"Converts faster, in parallel with reading the CD. If FFmpeg doesn't work on this device, the app's own converter is used"

"Native DSD and DoP are used only when bit-perfect playback is on. Otherwise, DSD is converted to PCM"
"Nearly indistinguishable from the CD. About 10 MB per song"

"On: upsamples only by integer multiples (e.g. 44.1 → 176.4 kHz) for the cleanest result. If the output doesn't accept any integer multiple, the output's rate is used instead and a warning appears in red.\nOff: uses the highest rate the output accepts, including non-integer conversions (e.g. 44.1 → 192 kHz).\nUSB DAC direct output always uses integer multiples"

"This app uses jump3r unmodified, as a separate library (de.sciss:jump3r:1.0.5). "

"Used to convert ripped tracks to FLAC and MP3. FFmpeg is unmodified and is included as a separate program (lib/<ABI>/libffmpeg.so), built with tools/ffmpeg/build.sh in this app's repository. The build and how it was made are in the repository release "ffmpeg-8.1.3-2". "
"Built into FFmpeg (unmodified) for MP3 conversion. Licensed under the GNU LGPL version 2 or later."
"The AAC decoder built into the app uses the AAC code tables listed in FFmpeg's libavcodec, and its HE-AAC part (SBR and parametric stereo) is ported to Kotlin from FFmpeg's aacsbr and aacps code. "
"Ported to Kotlin as the app's built-in MP3 decoder (layers I, II and III), for devices that can't decode MP3 themselves."
